script_text: Stop! Taurus, the stars are violently rearranging your reality today. Transiting Pluto is creating a brutal opposition to your ruling planet Venus in your 7th House of Partnerships. This alignment is shaking your Earth element foundations and forcing you to confront hidden power dynamics you have ignored for months. If you are single, you are attracting someone who challenges your deepest boundaries rather than offering comfort. You must assert your authority now to prevent Earth element stability from being undermined by delays. Avoid isolating yourself, because a sudden blessing of unexpected financial clarity is heading your way. Follow for tomorrow's reading to see how this intense energy resolves.
